title: 002 我的爸爸融化了-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    没有错，爸爸融化了。

    像是夏日阳光下的草莓香草冰淇淋，红的白的，流淌下来。

    “7856，我是疯了吗？我看到我爸爸融化了。”

    晏梨问道，但并没有期待7856的回答。

    她突然想起了文森特临死前的话，世界末日来临，他是唯一的救世主。

    而她刚刚完美地杀死了救世主。

    她的手微微上抬，瞄准镜里的画面上移，一颗生满尖刺，像牛又像马的绿皮怪物脑袋，突然占据了她的整个视线。

    突然之间，那怪物一个转头，朝着旁边的一个女人喷出了蛮涎。

    紧接着，晏梨看到，那个牵着红衣小女孩的母亲，站在原地融化了。

    晏梨猛地抬头，她一个跨步踩上了天台边缘的栏杆，然后纵身一跃径直地从酒店楼顶跳了下去。

    速降绳快速的拉得笔直，晏梨松掉腰间的卡扣，轻轻地落在了地上。

    地球像是水已经到了沸点的开水壶，所有生灵开始一起尖叫。

    晏梨站在高楼中央，仰头看向了狭缝中的天空，不知道从什么时候起，一棵遮天蔽日的黑色金属巨树悄无声息的拔地而起，那张牙舞爪的枝丫在夜晚灯光的映照下，散发出五彩斑斓的金属光泽。

    在那树枝上，生长着密密麻麻的宛若虫卵一般的黑色圆形果实。

    一阵微风吹过，成熟的果实掉落下来，像是下雨一般，轻轻地砸向了地面。

    在落地的一瞬间，果实裂开了一条缝，带着腥臭的怪物鱼贯而出……

    “妈妈！救命！”

    “我草！那是什么鬼！”

    “弟弟化掉了！呜呜呜……”

    “啊！死人了！警察警察！”

    晏梨深吸了一口气，果断地抬起枪瞄准了其中一只怪物，扣动了扳机。

    子弹击中怪物的额头，然后落在了地面上，怪物毫发无伤。

    晏梨面色一沉，心中瞬间生起了不好的预感。

    “7856，你还在吗？怪物很有可能无法被热武器破防。”

    她说着，再一次扣动扳机，冲着另外一只不同类型的怪物开枪，结果依旧是毫无结果。

    就在这个时候，突然一阵夹杂着腥臭的劲风从背后袭来，晏梨下意识的就地一滚，离开了原来的位置。

    她将狙击枪背在身后，伸手在腰间一摸，摸出了一把短刀，盯住了攻击她的怪物。

    这是一只生得有些像老鼠的怪异生物，它的头颅是标准的等边三角形，身体却是八面棱柱体，尾巴则是孔雀一般的扇形尾，简直就像是几何学从书中走了出来，并生出了一个混血儿。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

That’s right, Dad melted.

Like strawberry vanilla ice cream under the summer sun, red and white, flowing down.

"7856, am I crazy? I saw my dad melting."

Yan Li asked, but did not expect 7856's answer.

She suddenly remembered Vincent’s words before he died: the end of the world is coming, and he is the only savior.

And she just killed the savior perfectly.

She raised her hand slightly, and the picture in the scope moved up. A green-skinned monster head covered with spikes, resembling a cow and a horse, suddenly occupied her entire sight.

Suddenly, the monster turned its head and spat out saliva at a woman next to it.

Immediately afterwards, Yan Li saw the mother holding the little girl in red standing there and melting.

Yan Li raised her head suddenly, stepped on the railing at the edge of the rooftop, and then jumped straight off the roof of the hotel.

The rappel rope was quickly pulled straight, Yan Li loosened the buckle at her waist and landed gently on the ground.

The earth is like a kettle whose water has reached the boiling point, and all living creatures begin to scream together.

Yan Li stood in the middle of the high-rise building, looking up at the sky in the slit. She didn't know when a giant black metal tree that covered the sky and the sun rose up quietly from the ground. The branches with claws and claws exuded a colorful metallic luster under the reflection of the night lights.

On the branch, there are densely packed black round fruits that look like insect eggs.

A breeze blew by, and the ripe fruits fell down, gently hitting the ground like rain.

The moment it hit the ground, the fruit cracked open, and smelly monsters came out...

"Mom! Help!"

"What the hell!"

"My brother has melted! Woohoo..."

"Ah! Someone's dead! Police, police!"

Yan Li took a deep breath, decisively raised the gun, aimed at one of the monsters, and pulled the trigger.

The bullet hit the monster’s forehead and then fell on the ground, leaving the monster unscathed.

Yan Li's face darkened, and a bad premonition suddenly arose in her heart.

"7856, are you still here? It is very likely that the monster cannot be broken by thermal weapons."

She said, pulling the trigger again and shooting at another monster of a different type, but the result was still fruitless.

At this moment, a strong gust of wind mixed with a fishy smell suddenly hit from behind. Yan Li subconsciously rolled on the spot and left her original position.

She put the sniper rifle behind her back, reached for her waist, took out a short knife, and stared at the monster attacking her.

This is a strange creature that looks a bit like a mouse. Its head is a standard equilateral triangle, its body is an octagonal prism, and its tail is a peacock-like fan-shaped tail. It is as if geometry came out of a book and gave birth to a hybrid child.
